scope: Current working-tree notebooks in _toc.yml. Chapter summaries include content sections only; exclude landing pages and assignments. Nested supporting readings are included if published as content.
method: Prose words are approximate tokens in markdown outside fenced blocks, directives/options, anchors, HTML tags/comments and URLs; headings, tables, captions, inline identifiers and footnotes remain. Markdown words count the entire markdown source. Code words/lines are separate. Saved outputs excluded from words. Notebook cells include empty cells and hidden solutions; Markdown pages are counted as one synthetic markdown cell and identified by format. Thresholds flag review candidates, not quality failures.
